scientific_integrity: The exact finite-radius singular spectrum and asymptotic statements are proved analytically; finite numerical tests are supplementary, not infinite-dimensional certificates. Publication priority and independent mathematical validation are unverified.
scientific_limitations: Only the analytic-to-first-excited-level transfer for centered hard disks in one complex dimension; each Schatten exponent and counting threshold is fixed. Earlier equivalent interlevel formulas under another normalization remain a residual originality risk.
title: Boundary-Gaussian singular spectrum of disk transfer between the first two Landau levels
